subtitle: Britain's self-styled home of surfing, and in 2026 Fistral became the Cornish anchor of a ~1,900-claimant nuisance suit against South West Water.
spike_statement: South West Water discharged sewage in the Newquay area 221 times in 2024, and in 2026 Fistral became the Cornish anchor of a ~1,900-claimant nuisance suit.

levers.photo_tone: Slate-teal Atlantic swell breaking off Towan Head under flat Cornish light, wetsuited lineups at the water's edge, the sand gone dun-colored near the storm-drain outfalls
